title: Empty log crashes with a traceback
body: Our controller writes the header line as soon as a program starts, so an aborted firing leaves a log with no readings. `kiln report` on that file dies with `IndexError: list index out of range` instead of saying the log is empty. It should print a one-line error and exit non-zero.

title: Hold time is wrong for the glaze firing
body: glaze-0921 held at cone 6 for twenty minutes, and the controller agrees, but `kiln report samples/glaze-0921.csv` says `Hold 0h06m`. The bisque log comes out right. The difference is that the new controller logs every five minutes instead of every minute.

title: JSON output for the report
body: I would like to chart firings in a spreadsheet, so `kiln report --json` printing the summary (peak, hold, segments with rates, anomalies) as JSON would be ideal. Timestamps should be ISO 8601 and durations in seconds.

title: Log errors should say which line is bad
body: `kiln: bisque.csv: bad temperature 'ERR'` does not say where, and the logs are hundreds of lines long. Every reader error should include the line number, as `file:line: message`.
